title: Live MSC mode: render critical-point dots (max/min/saddle)
description:
PATCH-26 added MSC ShaderMode but only renders arcs as black lines. Critical-point dots (red=max, blue=min, yellow=saddle) are present in the CPU PNG diagnostic but missing from the live viewer. Quick polish so the live MSC mode matches the offline diagnostic.

Implementation: in HalfEdgeMeshRuntime, allocate a separate VBO per critical-point type, draw via glDrawElements(GL_POINTS) with point-size ~8.0 and a per-call color uniform. Route through PATCH-17 depth-aware shader so dots get correct occlusion.

In MeshNodeViewerScene.applyMscOverlay, push critical-point vertex IDs grouped by type, alongside the arc edges already sent to setFeatureEdgeOverlay.

Critical files:
- ixdar-app/src/main/java/ixdar/graphics/render/model/HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.java
- ixdar-app/src/main/java/ixdar/scenes/mesh/MeshNodeViewerScene.java
definition-of-done:
1. Live MSC mode shows colored dots at every retained critical point.
2. Dots are PATCH-17 depth-aware (back-of-mesh dots occluded).
3. Colors match the CPU PNG diagnostic (red max, blue min, yellow saddle).
testing-plan:
1. Live viewer skull, P + D MORSE_SMALE + Shift+P to MSC. Confirm dots visible at expected anatomical bumps / sockets / saddles.
2. Orbit to confirm depth occlusion.
